hints.title: Mapping Lookup Matrix
hints.text: Character sub[j] can match s[i] if sub[j] == s[i] or (sub[j], s[i]) is in the allowed replacements.

hints.title: Lookup Set Precomputation
hints.text: Store all valid (old, new) replacement pairs in a hash set for constant-time character validation.

hints.title: Slide Window over Text
hints.text: Test each starting position in s from 0 to len(s) - len(sub), checking character-by-character compatibility.

hints.title: Substring Pattern Matching Implementation

complexity.notes: With m <= 5000 and n <= 5000, early mismatch exits make this fast.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substring combinations without constant set lookups causes string allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set stores k allowed replacement pairs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate structures allowed character pairs with O(1) set lookup and early breaking.
